title: LYA ToolDescriptor (layer L4, procedural)
description: One registered capability. Rule from 06-SKILL-LIBRARY.md, made machine-checkable: no capability without a registered matcher, a tier, and a test.

matcher.description: Deterministic pattern (regex/keyword set). Routing must not need a model (T0 tier).

tier.description: Must exist in security/policy.py. Not in a tier = the capability does not exist.

fast.description: true = no model call, no network. Fast path budget < 100 ms.

idempotent.description: false = the executor must record an idempotency key and never blind-retry.

test.description: Name of the offline test that proves it. No test = status is 'unverified', never 'done'.

args_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema for arguments; used to validate a generated plan before execution.
